seo.title: About Dr. Neda Moezzi | Valencia Smile Expert
seo.description: Meet Dr. Neda Moezzi and the Valencia Smile Expert team in Santa Clarita: holistic, one-on-one dentistry with 3D imaging, PRF therapy and same-day crowns.

sections.heading: Dentistry with heart, in Valencia since 2007.
sections.lead: Valencia Smile Expert blends clinical precision and modern technology with a warm, one-on-one approach. Dr. Neda Moezzi leads every visit herself, so you are never handed off and never rushed.

image.alt: Dr. Neda Moezzi seated with three members of her team

sections.heading: Santa Clarita's trusted dental home
body: The practice has served Santa Clarita families since 2007. Under Dr. Moezzi it has grown into a place where advanced care and genuine kindness sit side by side: a calm office, a small team that knows your name, and a dentist who treats every patient the way she would treat her own family.

Her mission from the start has been simple. High-quality dentistry should be accessible, compassionate and truly patient-centered, whether you are here for a routine cleaning or a full smile reconstruction.

image.alt: Dr. Neda Moezzi with her dental team in the office

sections.heading: The values behind every appointment
sections.lead: We practice holistic, integrative dentistry: we look beyond the symptom to the cause, choose biocompatible materials, and plan for your long-term health rather than a quick fix.

items.title: Individualized attention
items.text: Every patient, every visit, gets our full focus. You see Dr. Moezzi herself, every time.

items.title: Holistic approach
items.text: We consider your whole-body wellness and use biocompatible, mercury-free materials.

items.title: Long-term outlook
items.text: Prevention, education and lasting solutions over short-term patches.

items.title: Comfort and clarity
items.text: Sedation options, plain-language explanations and a friendly, unhurried atmosphere.

items.title: Excellence in care
items.text: Advanced technology and proven techniques, with no shortcuts.

items.title: Honesty and transparency
items.text: Options and costs explained up front. No surprises.

items.title: Community commitment
items.text: Serving Santa Clarita, Valencia, Stevenson Ranch, Newhall, Saugus and Canyon Country with pride.

items.title: Flexible scheduling
items.text: Convenient appointment times and same-day care when you need it.

sections.heading: Led by Dr. Neda Moezzi, DDS
sections.lead: Founder and lead provider, known for compassionate care, technical precision and the long-term relationships she builds with patients.

sections.heading: Comfort meets innovation
sections.lead: Our office is equipped for safe, efficient and minimally invasive care, combined with a calming environment and sedation options.

items.title: 3D CBCT imaging
items.text: Detailed three-dimensional scans for precise diagnosis and guided implant planning.

items.title: iTero digital scanning
items.text: Comfortable digital impressions for Invisalign, crowns and smile previews. No goopy trays.

items.title: PRF therapy
items.text: Platelet-rich fibrin from your own blood to support healing after surgery and grafting.

items.title: Guided implant surgery
items.text: Implants placed with a surgical guide planned on your CBCT scan for accuracy and comfort.

items.title: In-house crowns
items.text: Custom crowns designed and made on site, so many patients leave with the final crown the same day.

items.title: Intraoral cameras
items.text: See what we see. Clear images make it easier to understand your options.

items.title: Laser dentistry
items.text: Precise, gentle treatment of soft tissue with less bleeding and faster recovery.

items.title: Sedation options
items.text: Comfort choices for anxious patients and longer procedures, discussed at your consultation.

sections.heading: A calm space on Tourney Road
sections.lead: Bright treatment rooms, modern equipment and a team that greets you by name.

sections.heading: Everything under one roof
sections.lead: Dr. Moezzi's expertise spans the full spectrum of dental care, from your child's first checkup to smile restoration.

categories.title: Preventive care
categories.text: Routine cleanings, exams, oral cancer screenings and education to keep your smile healthy year round.

categories.title: Family dentistry
categories.text: Care for all ages, including infant exams, pediatric treatments and ongoing care for adults and seniors.

categories.title: Cosmetic dentistry
categories.text: Whitening, veneers, Invisalign and smile makeovers customized to your goals.

categories.title: Restorative & surgical
categories.text: Crowns, bridges, implants, bone grafting and PRF-supported surgery for advanced needs.

sections.heading: Trusted by Santa Clarita families
sections.lead: Unedited words from patients who found their dental home here.

sections.heading: Come see the office
sections.lead: 27420 Tourney Rd, Suite 240, in Valencia. Free parking and an elevator to the second floor.

sections.heading: Become part of the family.
sections.text: Schedule your consultation with Dr. Moezzi today. New patients receive a comprehensive exam and X-rays for $59.
